newsitem.title: USA: U S West Media Group Q1 shr loss $0.20.
newsitem.headline: U S West Media Group Q1 shr loss $0.20.

text.p: (All data above in millions except per share numbers)
First Call estimates were for a loss of $0.25 a share.
1996 average common shares outstanding, loss and share loss figures are pro forma amounts.
The 1996 amounts are pro forma as if the Continental Cablevison merger occurred January 1, 1996.
U S West reported a 16 percent increase in operating cash flow, to $620 million. Media Group's operating cash flow for first quarter 1996 was $533 million on a pro forma basis.

Because Media Group participates in numerous joint ventures, the company uses proportionate accounting to reflect its relative share of operating revenues and expenses associated with these operations.
U S West Inc is composed of U S West Communications Inc and U S West Media Group.
